Subject: Discovery follow-up: schedule demo / loop in security & procurement (FinPath)

Hi Jordan —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our call: 
- Primary goal: reduce per-inquiry latency for customer-facing search/assistant and centralize embedding pipeline (target: <100ms tail latency for queries).
- Success metrics: 30% reduction in infra cost per 1M queries, 99.9% availability during business hours, and drift checks on embeddings.
- Timeline: evaluating vendor shortlist in Feb–Mar, pilot in Apr, production rollout in Q2.
- Tech notes: FinPath will likely need VPC/private deployment for PII data in search index; typical request sizes ~256 tokens.

Next step: schedule a technical deep dive + demo with our platform engineer to review integration patterns, network requirements, and a short performance preview. I can bring our Security PM to cover SOC2 and deployment controls.

Proposed slots (all PT):
- Tue Mar 2 — 10:00–10:45am PT
- Wed Mar 3 — 1:00–1:45pm PT

Can you confirm which works for you and the folks you mentioned (security/procurement)? If easier, share a few times and I’ll coordinate. I attached a one-page Mutual Action Plan to help align next steps.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com
(415) 555-0192
